instruction.name: xvdiv.d
instruction.description: Divide each signed 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element in `b`.

experiments.name: dependent chain with element-0 reset helper
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'xvdiv.d $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 8.99 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 4000, iters 500.
